def run(scene, robot):
    a = scene.get("white cylinder")
    b = scene.get("gray block")
    ax, ay = a.x, a.y
    bx, by = b.x, b.y
    size = max(a.w, a.d, b.w, b.d) + 2
    tx, ty = scene.free_spot(size=(size, size), clearance=3, avoid=[(ax, ay, a.w+4, a.d+4), (bx, by, b.w+4, b.d+4)])
    robot.move(a, tx, ty)
    robot.move(scene.get(b.name), ax, ay)
    robot.move(scene.get(a.name), bx, by)

def run(scene, robot):
    a = scene.get("white cylinder")
    b = scene.get("gray block")
    ax, ay = a.x, a.y
    bx, by = b.x, b.y
    side = max(a.w, a.d, b.w, b.d) + 2
    robot.move(a, *scene.free_spot(size=(side, side), clearance=3))
    robot.move(scene.get(b.name), ax, ay)
    robot.move(scene.get(a.name), bx, by)
